protocols.name: platform.file.write
protocols.consumerImpact: Local operator runbook keeps a bounded target write; no legacy command parity is promised (reference shows no external consumer).
protocols.notes: Writes one bounded marker file inside an owned synthetic target directory; never an arbitrary path.

protocols.name: platform.file.probe
protocols.consumerImpact: Read-only local presence check retained; a read creates no effect.
protocols.notes: Observes a bounded target fact through the real filesystem; refuses any caller-supplied path.

protocols.name: platform.credential.presence
protocols.consumerImpact: Credential presence is verified locally without exposing the credential value.
protocols.notes: Real native check: the target credential file must exist as a non-empty regular file with owner-only (0600) permissions; only presence and mode are observed, never the secret content.

protocols.name: platform.target.release
protocols.consumerImpact: Release-class effect kept behind its own destructive-release grant; synthetic targets only.
protocols.notes: Exercised against synthetic targets only; a real release additionally needs the human operator at a real terminal.

protocols.name: evidence.http.read
protocols.consumerImpact: An authenticated evidence HTTP binding stays compatibility-dependent; it is never a public admin bypass and is not mounted here.
protocols.notes: Recorded for parity; not implemented in this unit. The canonical interface is the local stdin/stdout JSON envelope.

protocols.name: platform.cdk.deploy
protocols.consumerImpact: Cloud deployment is a recorded disposition, not a runtime dependency; no paid fallback is added under the $0 budget.
protocols.notes: Recorded only; ops/cdk stacks are cloud-dependent and out of the $0/local budget.

protocols.name: platform.cloudwatch.publish
